class.name: HeightmapFiller
class.brief_description: C++ accelerated heightmap chunk filler for planet terrain generation.
class.description: Replaces the GDScript heightmap fill loop which iterates 512² = 262,144 cells, each performing 8 noise samples + a Voronoi tectonic query. Moving this tight loop into C++ provides ~50-100× speedup. Usage: create once, configure noise layers and tectonic data, then call [method fill_chunk] per chunk.

method.name: set_noise_layers
method.description: Sets the 8 terrain noise layers. Must be called before [method fill_chunk].

method.name: set_warp_noises
method.description: Sets the 3 domain-warp noises used for tectonic border warping.

method.name: set_tectonic_data
method.description: Passes all pre-baked tectonic data arrays from PlateTectonics into C++.

method.name: set_amplitudes
method.description: Sets the amplitude constants for each noise layer.

method.name: set_half_widths
method.description: Sets the boundary half-widths for mountain, trench, and rift masks.

method.name: fill_chunk
method.description: Fills a heightmap chunk and returns a PackedFloat32Array of resolution² height values.

members.member: Domain warp strength for tectonic border warping.
